title: Interior Designer Portfolio
description: A website that lets an interior designer's work do the selling.
constraints: The site had to make premium work feel premium online without burying it in a heavy browsing experience.
problem: The designer relied on word of mouth and an old social media profile, but prospective clients wanted to see finished projects before getting in touch.
solution: Designed and built a fast portfolio site with large project photos, a simple layout, and a way to request a consultation from every project.
result: The designer has one link to share in place of scattered social posts when he pitches larger projects.
